An anchor-wrapped table inside a layout cell keeps its inner links clickable

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<table><tr><td><a href=\"/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"/one\">One</a><a href=\"/two\">Two</a></td></tr></table></a></td></tr><tr><td>After</td></tr></table>", new ConversionOptions { BrInTables = true, CompactTables = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
